items.prompt: The orders table only has customer_id. How do you show who ordered?
items.explanation: JOIN combines rows from two tables whose values match.
customer_id in orders points to id in customers. Other pairings mix up the people.

items.prompt: Why write orders.id instead of just id?
choices: id exists in both tables, so you must say which
It is required in every query
items.explanation: When two tables share a column name, SQL needs to know which one you mean.
